author: Xu Han
note: Learning/portfolio demonstrator. NOT a calibrated observatory simulator, NOT an exposure-time calculator, NOT a reproduction of HARMONI/MUSE/NIRSpec, and NOT a validated performance prediction.
snr_interpretation: median_line_snr excludes unavailable full-window measurements; a missing value is not a physical non-detection. Read finite_snr_fraction (usable spaxel fraction) and median_line_snr_finite_only (median over usable spaxels) alongside it. The joint weighted deblend also masks neighbours whose flux cannot be identified after a bad detector row; it does not replace missing information by interpolation.
limitations: Controlled inverse mapping, not a real reduction pipeline.

The historical per-trace Horne estimator can over-count shared trace flux; the joint deblend instead solves all traces at once and masks unstable coefficients; the pipeline's science products default to the nearest read-out.

Per-method SNR pairs each flux estimator with its own propagated variance (nearest look-up vs joint least-squares covariance diagonal). These per-spaxel SNR comparisons do not use aperture spatial covariance.
Missing full-window flux/SNR remains NaN; coverage is not a correction for lost line photons.
Trace offset biases flux and velocity; residual-noise covariance is an illustrative sample estimate.
